CREATE TABLE "public"."Setting" (
  "address" text,
  "companyName" text NOT NULL,
  "companyNameAr" text,
  "companyTrn" text,
  "documentReminderDays" int4 DEFAULT 30 NOT NULL,
  "email" text,
  "id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "phone" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "version" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "workdayEnd" text NOT NULL,
  "workdayStart" text NOT NULL,
  "workingDays" jsonb NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Setting_documentReminderDays_range_fd011ea6" CHECK ("documentReminderDays" BETWEEN 0 AND 365),
  CONSTRAINT "Setting_single_row_99dee7f0" CHECK ("id" = 1),
  CONSTRAINT "Setting_workday_format_e04f78ac" CHECK ("workdayStart" ~ '^[0-2][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]$' AND "workdayEnd" ~ '^[0-2][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]$')
)
